title: Bank Deposit Service Tiers: Payout Rails, Funding Methods and Entry Requirements
content:
Bank Deposit pays a personal transfer into the recipient's bank account. It is offered in six service tiers, and each tier fixes the payout rail the money travels on, the ways the customer may pay for the transfer, and the minimum standing a Personal Sender Account needs before that tier can be booked.

## Terms of the tiers

1. **Payout rail.** Each tier pays out on one rail: local batch, local real time, or SWIFT.
2. **Funding methods.** Each tier accepts only the funding methods listed for it below. The level of the customer's Personal Sender Account may narrow that list further.
3. **Lowest account level.** The entry level is the lowest Personal Sender Account level (by its official name) that may book the tier.
4. **Completed transfers.** The entry count is the fewest completed personal transfers the customer needs before booking the tier.

## Tier table

| Tier | Payout rail | Funding methods accepted | Lowest account level | Completed personal transfers needed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bank Deposit Economy | Local batch | ACH debit | Paloma Starter | 0 |
| Bank Deposit Standard | Local batch | ACH debit, pay-by-bank | Paloma Verified | 3 |
| Bank Deposit Express | Local real time | Debit card, credit card, pay-by-bank | Paloma Starter | 0 |
| Bank Deposit Express Plus | Local real time | Debit card, credit card, pay-by-bank | Paloma Verified Plus | 5 |
| Bank Deposit Large Amount | Local batch | Wire, pay-by-bank | Paloma Enhanced | 5 |
| Bank Deposit International Wire | SWIFT | ACH debit, debit card, pay-by-bank, wire | Paloma Verified | 0 |

## Reading the table

- **Which tiers take a card?** Only Bank Deposit Express and Bank Deposit Express Plus accept a credit card; those two and Bank Deposit International Wire accept a debit card.
- **Which tiers take a wire?** Bank Deposit Large Amount and Bank Deposit International Wire.
- **Which tiers need a transfer history?** Bank Deposit Standard needs 3 completed personal transfers; Bank Deposit Express Plus and Bank Deposit Large Amount each need 5. The other three tiers need none.
- **Rail families.** Economy, Standard and Large Amount pay out on the local batch rail; Express and Express Plus on the local real-time rail; International Wire on SWIFT.

*Hypothetical illustration:* a customer at Paloma Verified with 4 completed personal transfers who wishes to pay by pay-by-bank meets the entry figures of Bank Deposit Standard (Paloma Verified, 3 transfers) and of Bank Deposit Express (Paloma Starter, 0 transfers), but not those of Bank Deposit Express Plus (Paloma Verified Plus, 5 transfers) or Bank Deposit Large Amount (Paloma Enhanced, 5 transfers).
